data.case_title: Late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag) for 2023 income tax
data.title: Late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag) of €75.00 for the 2023 income tax return
data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf has set a late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag) of €75.00 under § 152 AO because the 2023 income tax return was filed late, payable within one month of notification. The letter also states an objection (Einspruch) right within the same one-month period.
data.explanation: The tax office is charging you a €75.00 penalty for filing your 2023 income tax return late. You must pay this amount by the deadline shown, which is calculated from when this letter is considered delivered. If you disagree with the surcharge, you may file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the tax office; the app shows until when you can do so. If you neither pay nor object in time, the surcharge becomes final and enforceable, and further collection steps (with added costs) may follow. If you're unsure whether the surcharge is justified, consider asking a tax advisor (Steuerberater) before the deadline shown.

items.title: Pay the late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag)
items.action: Transfer €75.00 to the tax office's account by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: Late payment may lead to reminder fees or enforcement measures by the tax office.
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Betrag innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the surcharge, submit an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically to Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you don't object in time, the assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe bei der erlassenden Behörde schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen.

key_facts.label: Late filing surcharge (Verspätungszuschlag)
key_facts.quote: Nach § 152 AO wird ein Verspätungszuschlag in Höhe von 75,00 € festgesetzt.

remedy.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist der Einspruch zulässig.

data.tax_note: This surcharge relates to the 2023 income tax return; the surcharge itself is a non-deductible penalty, but keep this notice with your 2023 tax records.
